schools.title: Schools

schoolForm.title: Create school
schoolForm.description: The school starts as Pending. Activate it from the list to create its super admin.
schoolForm.emailHint: Also the super admin's login. It can't belong to another account.
schoolForm.languageHint: The language the school's site opens in.
schoolForm.emailLocked: This is the super admin's login, so it can't change after activation.

reactivate.title: Reactivate {name}?
reactivate.description: Its users can log in again and its site opens again.

suspend.title: Suspend {name}?
suspend.description: Nobody at the school can log in and its site goes offline until you reactivate it. Nothing is deleted.

deactivate.title: Deactivate {name}?
deactivate.description: The school is closed: nobody can log in and its site goes offline. Nothing is deleted, and you can reactivate it later.

resetPassword.title: Reset the super admin's password?
resetPassword.description: {email} gets a new password and is logged out on every device.

resetDone.title: New temporary password

branding.faviconHint: The small icon in the browser tab.

subjects.title: NCTB subjects
subjects.description: The shared subject list every school picks its subjects from.

deleteDialog.title: Delete {name}?

currentDialog.description: Lists, admissions and attendance open in the current year by default.

deleteDialog.description: Only possible while no student was ever enrolled in it and nothing is set up for it. Its sections are deleted too.

deleteDialog.title: Delete {name}?
deleteDialog.description: Only possible while no student was ever enrolled in it. Its year settings are deleted too.

groups.title: Groups
groups.description: Streams like Science, Business Studies and Humanities. Students and subjects can belong to a group.

deleteDialog.title: Delete {name}?
deleteDialog.description: Only possible while no student was ever in it and no subject is assigned to it.

subjects.description: The NCTB subjects every school can use, plus your school's own. Choose each class's subjects on the class subjects page.

removeDialog.description: Only possible while it isn't in an exam routine and no student chose it as their 4th subject.

teachers.description: The school's teachers. Each one logs in with their mobile number.
